critique: The render strongly reads as a dense white blizzard on black, with convincing multilayered snow density and a good fine-particle field at t1. Motion/depth progression is still too aggressive by t4: numerous foreground flakes have expanded into large, soft, overbright discs, especially near the upper-left, upper-right, and lower-right edges. This makes the effect feel like particles rapidly flying into the camera rather than the more consistently scaled snowfall implied by the Blizzard preset thumbnail.

suggestions.why: Reduce the strong toward-camera Z wind so foreground flakes do not rush into extreme perspective size over only a few frames.
Lower overall particle velocity to soften the t1-to-t4 depth acceleration while preserving the dense blizzard motion.
